data.text: Before we choose, I propose 10 tons each this month. That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, so next month’s stock reaches 100 whether natural replenishment happens or the remaining fish double. We can keep earning that each month if we all stick to it. Taking 19 each would pay more now, but leave just 5 tons—and a 25% chance of starting next month with only 10. Let’s agree to equal 10-ton limits and review everyone’s revealed catches together afterward. John, would you support that?
